● Milli-Q® IQ 7000 Ultrapure Water System
● Water Quality: Type 1 Ultrapure Water (Exceeding ASTM/ISO/USP standards).

● Dispensing: Q-POD® interface with 0.05 to 2.0 L/min variable flow.

● Applications: HPLC, LC-MS, and critical cell culture workflows.

● Performance: Variable speed range of 300 – 3500 RPM with precision digital control.
